BOX 18.3  CLINICAL APPLICATIONS
Unique Challenges in Evaluating Protein-Energy Nutritional Status
in Patients on HD and PD
As already noted, many patients with
CKD, especially those on HD and PD, 
have protein-energy malnutrition 
resulting from a wide variety of fac-
tors. Anthropometric measurements, 
biochemical assessment values, and nu-
trient intake records provide important
nutrition assessment data to verify the
cause and extent of nutrition problems, 
especially malnutrition. Given the com-
plexity of CKD and its nutritional conse-
quences, interpretation and evaluation 
of laboratory results and protein intake
require unique critical thinking skills.
Serum albumin is a measure of both 
visceral protein status and acute-phase
inﬂ ammatory response, and there is
evidence that it is a predictor of morbid-
ity and mortality in individuals with
